_note: Translation of the Japanese draft. Traditional accounts remain attributed.

chapter.title: Battle of Okehazama
chapter.intro: Imagawa Yoshimoto, the famed archer who rules Suruga, Totomi and Mikawa, marches into Owari with a vast army. In the pouring rain, twenty-seven-year-old Oda Nobunaga leads a small force straight to Imagawa’s headquarters. The ambush will change the course of the Sengoku era.

長蛇.name: Long Serpent Formation
長蛇.intro: Troops march in a long single file. It suits narrow roads and valleys but leaves the flank exposed.

方円.name: Circle Formation
方円.intro: Troops form a defensive ring around their commander, ready for attacks from any direction.

鶴翼.name: Crane's Wing Formation
鶴翼.intro: Troops form a V like a crane's outstretched wings, enveloping attackers from both sides.

魚鱗.name: Fish Scale Formation
魚鱗.intro: Troops form layered triangles like fish scales, concentrating force to break the enemy line head-on.

雁行.name: Wild Geese Formation
雁行.intro: Troops march diagonally like geese in flight, ready to answer threats on the flank.

偃月.name: Crescent Moon Formation
偃月.intro: Troops form a crescent and charge behind their commander. It lifts morale while exposing the commander to danger.

総懸かり.name: Full Assault Formation
総懸かり.intro: The whole army charges together, breaking formation for one decisive assault.

01_信长.name: Oda Nobunaga
01_信长.line: The young lord of Owari was called a fool for his outlandish dress. At Okehazama he made his name across Japan.

02_浓姬.name: Nohime
02_浓姬.line: Daughter of Saito Dosan, the Viper of Mino, and Nobunaga's principal wife. Also called Kicho, much of her life remains a mystery.

03_秀吉.name: Kinoshita Tokichiro (Toyotomi Hideyoshi)
03_秀吉.line: An agile retainer whom Nobunaga called Monkey, he would later rule Japan as Toyotomi Hideyoshi.

04_利家.name: Maeda Toshiie
04_利家.line: A flamboyant eccentric and master of the spear, he sought to win his way back into Nobunaga's service after his dismissal.

05_胜家.name: Shibata Katsuie
05_胜家.line: Feared as Demon Shibata, he was a fierce Oda commander who first served Nobunaga's younger brother Nobukatsu.

06_长秀.name: Niwa Nagahide
06_长秀.line: Called Goroza the Rice, he was as indispensable as rice itself: a dependable Oda retainer who could handle anything.

07_新介.name: Mori Shinsuke
07_新介.line: One of Nobunaga's mounted guards. The Chronicle of Lord Nobunaga records that he struck down Imagawa Yoshimoto at Okehazama.

08_阿市.name: Oichi
08_阿市.epithet: Great Beauty of the Sengoku Era
08_阿市.line: Nobunaga's sister, said to be the most beautiful woman in Japan. She later married Azai Nagamasa and was swept up in the upheaval of the age.

09_义元.name: Imagawa Yoshimoto
09_义元.epithet: Finest Bowman of the Eastern Sea Road
09_义元.line: Head of Suruga's distinguished Imagawa house. Often portrayed as a courtly figure, he was a capable daimyo who governed his domains well.

10_元康.name: Matsudaira Motoyasu (Tokugawa Ieyasu)
10_元康.line: A nineteen-year-old warrior from Mikawa raised by the Imagawa. In golden armor he carried provisions into Odaka Castle. He later became Tokugawa Ieyasu.

11_朝比奈.name: Asahina Yasutomo
11_朝比奈.line: A young Imagawa retainer, he took Washizu Fort in the opening fighting at Okehazama and stayed loyal after Yoshimoto's death.

12_直盛.name: Ii Naomori
12_直盛.line: Lord of Iinoya in Totomi and Naotora's father. He is said to have fought with the Imagawa and fallen at Okehazama.

13_宗信.name: Matsui Munenobu
13_宗信.line: Lord of Futamata Castle in Totomi and a veteran Imagawa commander, he died protecting Yoshimoto at Okehazama.

14_直虎.name: Ii Naotora
14_直虎.line: Naomori's only daughter took the religious name Jiro Hoshi. She would later lead the Ii house as its lady of the castle.

rules.falling: When you match tiles, the tiles above them drop.
rules.target10: Decisive battle! Clear all four Imagawa Yoshimoto tiles by the end of match 20 or lose.
